profile.summary: nnnick is a Senior JavaScript developer with deep expertise in Chart.js, specializing in canvas-based rendering, performance optimizations, and robust error handling. Their contributions demonstrate mastery of Chart.js internals—particularly radar, bar, line, and doughnut/pie chart types—alongside strong build system knowledge (Gulp) and version control practices. The developer excels in debugging complex rendering issues, improving tooltip functionality, and maintaining code quality through linting (JSHint). While focused on frontend JavaScript, their work reflects a holistic understanding of open-source library development, including documentation, CI/CD integration, and release management.

Canvas & Rendering: Custom chart type rendering (Radar, Bar, Line, Doughnut/Pie)
